_comment: RND-007: how a status is drawn on the enemy that carries it. One block per status id (combat/status.py). `sprite` is the rig drawn over the body; `colour` the procedural ring's ink when there is no art (the primitive fallback, SHOW_ENEMY_STATE_RINGS). `recolour` is read by the cut script (tools/asset_pipeline/cut_mark_brackets.py), not at draw time: the strip is recoloured offline. `box` is the art's own frame-box in source px, drawn at `over_body` x the body's drawn size. `fade` is how long before the status ends the art fades out. `shown_with_effects` gates the art: it shows only while a weapon the hero holds has one of these effects above 0 -- a mark nothing reads is noise (owner, 2026-09-24).

mark._note: The Rod's mark (1.5 s, SYNERGY_WINDOW_S). Raspberry, hue 340: reads as red but stays apart from fire's orange (22), the HP-bar red (~0) and thunder's violet (265). The Gigapack's own red is hue 14, too close to fire. Brackets from scifi_analyze_001 (the lock-on breathe, frames 109-119 then 0-2).
